purpose: Development feasibility: mechanically commanded pre-contact approaches to two task-valid regions, crossed with mild tabletop material tint. No prompt-conditioned donor generator. Whole visible tabletop appearance, not an isolated texture patch. Reference motions are not complete successful tasks.
validity: Record native sensor-time RGB/segmentation/depth, exact rendering shams and all-substep robot-scene contacts. Replay recorded commands in a fresh simulator without edits and require exact camera and physics arrays. Tint must change only table support with a 2-pixel antialias boundary allowance; depth and geometry exact. Future-only edits are appearance-mismatch stress tests until observation/future consistency arms are examined.
stopping_rule: Build only six fixed approach trajectories and their appearance variants. Keep every rejection. No target/controller/threshold search after policy outcomes. Stop before policy inference if geometric, rendering or codec eligibility fails.
repair_provenance: Third pre-policy reference attempt. Attempt 1 stopped: invisible diagnostic sites polluted masks and state-4 soup missed its goal. Attempt 2 fixed sites and controller timing (16-control ramp, 0.6 cap); geometry passed, but a few RGB changes <=2/255 in inspected frames lay outside the coarse mask. This attempt measures subpixel table visibility with 4x-resolution geometry-ID segmentation and max-pools its table coverage. Original RGB, depth, horizon, 2-pixel boundary allowance, zero outside-support change limit and all geometry gates remain unchanged. No policy outcomes were observed.
